attributes.name: Deep Purple Essentials
attributes.description: Together with Led Zeppelin and Black Sabbath, Deep Purple (formed in 1968), are widely considered one of the most significant and influential pioneers of metal and hard rock. Albums like 'In Rock' (1970), 'Fireball' (1971) and 'Machine Head' (1972) are regarded as classics by any standards, made by the legendary Mark II lineup: Ian Gillan, Richie Blackmore, Jon Lord, Roger Glover and Ian Paice. Several changes and hiatuses over the years haven’t stopped Deep Purple, who have stayed remarkably active. In April 2017, Deep Purple released 'InFinite,' their 20th studio album backed by the ongoing Long Goodbye Tour. (Photo: Rovi)

attributes.name: Purple Disco Machine's Nu Disco Classics
